$comment: Documents one batch's input as Llm::TestScopeInputBuilder builds it (app/services/llm/test_scope_input_builder.rb) — a PR is sent as several of these, one per group of screens, plus an 'other' batch for changes that reach no single screen. The Ruby builder is authoritative; this file exists so the evidence contract each LLM call receives is reviewable independently of a Ruby diff.

screens.description: From ScreenCatalog. labels are the Chinese texts found in the screen's view, partials and mounted Vue components — the only button/field names the model may use. The 'other' batch lists every screen without labels.

examples: 工單管理 › 新增工單

changes.description: From ScreenImpactLocator. Every change has a ref the model must cite in a case or explain in uncertain_items.

category.description: Only in the 'other' batch: why the change reaches no single screen.

glossary.description: model key => { name, attributes } from the target app's zh-TW activerecord locale
